profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Boeing Company
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer 4, Training Systems & Government Services; Direct Attack
profile.summary: I have over thirty years’ experience developing software in multiple industries. Among the industries I have worked in are simulation-based training for military aircraft, integrated-circuit handling equipment, handheld shop-floor devices, medical equipment (not life-critical), building automation and test/measurement equipment control. I enjoy customer interaction and have made numerous site visits in several of my positions. I have had substantial roles in system analysis & design as well as user-interface design. I have been a technical/team lead on multiple projects. Over the course of my career, in addition to normal software development tasks, I have been responsible for, and/or participated in, requirements gathering & management, proposals, estimates, customer meetings & presentations, coordination between multiple teams, task assignment & scheduling, deliverable project documentation, equipment specification & purchase, trade shows and miscellaneous administrative duties.

positions.title: Software Engineer 4, Training Systems & Government Services; Direct Attack
positions.description:
- Currently working on Instructor Software research & development
- Software Lead, Production Test Equipment for JDAM & SDB
- Member of multiple simulator program Instructor Software Teams; Technical Lead on two of them
- Principal Investigator of an Instructor Software research team
- Team member in multiple Instructor Software research & development projects
- Responsible for Instructor Software technical volumes and estimates in two successful proposals
- Estimates for multiple proposals and follow-on work
- Focal for my team's adoption of Agile development within our larger group
- Preparation and planning for, and participation in, industry trade show
- Architecture and design for internal application framework
- Extensive customer interaction
- Multiple site visits

positions.title: Software Engineer/Consultant
positions.description:
Client - American TeleCare, Inc.
- Extracting video-conferencing and data-gathering functionality from one telemedicine product and developing an application with fewer features for customers that needed fewer features.
- Consulting on user interface issues. 
- Part of a group that explored new architectures for future releases.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Consultant
positions.description:
Client - DataMyte, Inc.
- Part of a team developing software for a custom handheld data-collection device based on Windows CE.
- Analysis and design of core functionality
- Responsible for designing and implementing the user interface
- Final design and implementation of parts of the core functionality

positions.title: Software Project Lead
positions.description:
Aetrium purchased the Advantek, Inc., Handler Division in October of 1997 and my job moved with the division.
- Redesign and reimplementation of control software for parts of a modular integrated-circuit tray-handling system.
- Mentoring junior developers.

positions.title: Software Project Lead
positions.description:
- Project Lead for ground-up object-oriented redesign of test-handler control software. Responsible for requirements gathering, analysis and design for software to be used on current and future lines of handlers.
- Analysis, design and implementation of modifications to existing motion-control software for a new handler variant.
- Work direction and mentoring of junior developers in various research and development projects.
- Design and implementation of help system for handler software.
- Mentoring of junior developers in C++, MFC and object-oriented technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Consultant
positions.description:
Client - TSI, Inc.
- Assisting in the solution of difficult bugs and stabilization of application for a new release.
- Consulting on debugging, C++, user--interface and general development issues.

Client - Medical Graphics Corporation
- Analysis, design, and implementation of user interface and patient data management functions for respiratory diagnostic system software.
- Project scheduling and work direction responsibilities.
- Design and implementation of coding and software error-handling guidelines.
- Worked on establishing software development processes and procedures.
- Mentoring of software engineers in C++, MFC, ODBC, and object-oriented technologies.

positions.title: Senior Systems Developer
positions.description:
- Design and implementation of an application, using object-oriented techniques, that allows grocery managers to easily review and validate month-end physical inventory data.
- ODBC and SQL access to OS/2 DB2/2 database

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead designer responsible for requirements gathering, analysis and design for development of a core set of object-oriented classes of future products.
- Design and implementation of one internal and three commercial cross-platform applications for Windows, Macintosh and DOS.
- Implementation, enhancement, testing, and maintenance of a financial reporting modules and mainframe order entry and processing systems.

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Client - IBM Corporation
Maintenance and enhancement of several System/36 Operating System components: task initiation and termination, resource allocation, system security and parts of Operator Control Language (OCL).

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Co-op Position while at Oakland University
Designed, implemented, tested and maintained building-control software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, implemented, tested and maintained software to control magnetic testing and measurement equipment and collect, analyze and display data.

skills.name: Equally comfortable working with technical and non-technical people
